notes.title: About NPC
notes.notes:
The characters in Evil Dreams are not dummies, dutifully waiting for you to walk up and talk to them. Of course, we don't have the resources to provide a full life simulation, but we will do our best to provide an immersive experience in Evil Dreams!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41521934/c01a19aca0ed2d92f4a5cb8f25d5810c2413ffa4.gif[/img]

notes.title: About the structure of the game
notes.notes:
[b]Hi[/b]! We're experiencing a bit of production difficulties, but we still have a story to tell. The game will be divided into 3 chapters, during which you will have to untangle the tangle of events that took place in Marwood, travel between dream worlds and solve puzzles. Try not to get tangled up, because that's all we want..

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41521934/07c58f0e3ac574c92996844dfaaa9738852be0bc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41521934/e2e26536019dafc3f7d0368be4ff2f16e65b5cde.png[/img]

notes.title: Thanks for Next Fest and a little announcement!
notes.notes:
Hi all!
First: very grateful to everyone who played the demo at the festival and gave feedback. We saw and heard the flaws and fixed them (there probably won't be a demo on Steam anymore).
A little bit of what's been fixed:
*Added interactive mouse-rollable items
*Added more lines and reactions of Marcus to his surroundings
*Corrected typos and slightly shortened text
*We remembered we're making a horror, so we added some creepy elements.
And now the second: the most attentive of you probably thought that the game can play as a nightmares. So, we decided to remove this feature, because in our format of the game. But it only makes Evil Dreams better!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41521934/daa4c526dc38ace95017da662ad0ac5b0be23759.png[/img]
